About Intextify

Clearer construction planning, before work begins.

Intextify provides educational construction calculators and planning guides for homeowners, contractors, and civil-engineering learners in Pakistan.

What we do

Our tools turn basic project inputs into a preliminary material and cost breakdown. They are designed to help users ask better questions, compare quotations more consistently, and prepare for discussions with suppliers and qualified professionals.

What we do not do

Intextify does not replace a structural engineer, architect, contractor, site inspection, supplier quotation, or regulatory approval. Estimates are planning aids; local rates, specifications, waste, transport, labour scope, and site conditions can change the final cost.

Our editorial approach

We publish practical guides with a clear purpose, stated assumptions, and relevant disclaimers. Articles are reviewed for clarity and updated when the underlying information materially changes. Read our Editorial Policy for the standards we apply.

Contact

For corrections, partnerships, or editorial feedback, please use our contact page.
